sentences.text: Jessica Michelle Chastain -LRB- born March 24 , 1977 -RRB- is an American actress and film producer .
Born in Carmichael , California , and raised in Sacramento , Chastain developed an interest in acting from a young age .	Sacramento	Sacramento, California
In 1998 , she made her professional stage debut as Shakespeare 's Juliet .	Shakespeare	William Shakespeare	Juliet	Juliet

After studying acting at the Juilliard School , she was signed to a talent holding deal with the television producer John Wells .	Juilliard School	Juilliard School	talent holding deal	talent holding deal	John Wells	John Wells (TV producer)
She was a recurring guest star in several television shows , including Law & Order : Trial by Jury .

She also took on roles in the stage productions of Anton Chekhov 's play The Cherry Orchard in 2004 and Oscar Wilde 's tragedy Salome in 2006 .	Anton Chekhov	Anton Chekhov	The Cherry Orchard	The Cherry Orchard	Oscar Wilde	Oscar Wilde	Salome	Salome (play)	Oscar	Academy Award for Best Actress

Chastain made her film debut in the drama Jolene -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , and gained wide recognition in 2011 for starring roles in half a dozen films , including the dramas Take Shelter and The Tree of Life .	Jolene	Jolene (film)	Take Shelter	Take Shelter	The Tree of Life	The Tree of Life (film)
Her performance as an aspiring socialite in The Help earned her an Academy Award nomination .	The Help	The Help (film)	Academy Award	Academy Award

In 2012 , she won a Golden Globe Award and received a second Oscar nomination for playing a CIA agent in the thriller Zero Dark Thirty .	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture, Drama	Oscar	Academy Award for Best Actress	Zero Dark Thirty	Zero Dark Thirty
Chastain made her Broadway debut in a revival of The Heiress in the same year .	Broadway	Broadway theatre	The Heiress	The Heiress (1947 play)

Her highest-grossing releases came with the science fiction films Interstellar -LRB- 2014 -RRB- and The Martian -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , as she continued to draw praise for her performances in the dramas The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , A Most Violent Year -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , and Miss Sloane -LRB- 2016 -RRB- .	Interstellar	Interstellar (film)	The Martian	The Martian (film)	The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby	The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby	A Most Violent Year	A Most Violent Year	Miss Sloane	Miss Sloane
Chastain 's accolades include two Academy Award and British Academy Film Award nominations .	Academy Award	Academy Award	British Academy Film Award	British Academy Film Awards
She is known to prepare extensively for her roles .
Chastain is the founder of the production company Freckle Films , which was created to promote diversity in film .
She is vocal about social issues such as gender and racial equality , and mental health .
Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2012 .	Time	Time (magazine)	100 most influential people in the world	Time 100
